At this command, the two Titans, Shuka and Sarona, assuming

Terrified at the sight of Rama and despairing of their lives,

.. 0 Most Cherished Issue of the House of Raghu, we have

Hearing these words, Rama, the son of Dasaratha, who

" If you have inspected the whole army and examined their

Your arrest should not cause you any apprehen-

And you, when you return to the

Receiving this command, the two Titans, Shuka and Sarana,

Returning to Lanka, they said to the Lord of the Titans :-

brief.summary_1line: Ravana sends spies Shuka and Sarana to assess Rama’s monkey army, but Vibhishana exposes them and Rama releases them with a warning for Ravana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Two disguised demons stand among the vast roaring monkey army spread across mountains and waterfalls, trying in vain to count the endless ranks.
Vibhishana points accusingly at the captured spies before Rama while the monkey warriors crowd around in suspicion.
Rama calmly orders the frightened spies to be released and sends them back with a stern message to Ravana.
